label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 147 ]

blocks.text: In many countries, overcrowded cities face a major problem. This has been mainly caused by the drift of large numbers of people from the rural areas, these people have become dissatisfied with the traditional life of farming, and have come to the cities hoping for better work and pay. Unfortunately, however, poor conditions in the urban areas, such as lack of housing, worsening sanitation and unemployment, bring about an increase in poverty, disease and crime.

The only long-term solution is to make life in the rural areas more attractive, which would encourage people to stay there. This could be achieved by providing incentives for people to go and work in the villages. Facilities in the rural areas, such as transport, health, and education services, should be improved to foster a more positive attitude to rural life. The improvement for rural lives is doubly important, because the cities themselves cannot be developed without the prior development of the rural areas.

readingSentences.korean: 많은 나라에서, 인구과밀 도시들은 주요 문제에 직면해 있다.

readingSentences.english: This has been mainly caused by the drift of large numbers of people from the rural areas, these people have become dissatisfied with the traditional life of farming, and have come to the cities hoping for better work and pay.
readingSentences.korean: 이는 주로 외곽 지역으로부터의 대규모의 인구유입에 기인하며, 이런 사람들은 전통적인 농업 생활에 만족하지 못해서, 더 나은 직업과 보수를 바라며 대도시로 몰려들었다.

readingSentences.english: Unfortunately, however, poor conditions in the urban areas, such as lack of housing, worsening sanitation and unemployment, bring about an increase in poverty, disease and crime.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나, 불행히도 주택 문제, 위생 악화, 실업 등의 도시 지역의 악조건이 빈곤, 질병, 범죄의 증가를 가져왔다.

readingSentences.english: The only long-term solution is to make life in the rural areas more attractive, which would encourage people to stay there.
readingSentences.korean: 유일한 장기적인 해결책은 농촌 지역의 생활을 더 매력적으로 만드는 것인데, 왜냐하면 그것이 사람들이 거기에 머물도록 장려할 것이기 때문이다.

readingSentences.english: This could be achieved by providing incentives for people to go and work in the villages.
readingSentences.korean: 이는 사람들이 농촌으로 가서 일하도록 유인책 제공함으로써 달성될 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: Facilities in the rural areas, such as transport, health, and education services, should be improved to foster a more positive attitude to rural life.
readingSentences.korean: 교통, 의료, 교육 서비스와 같은 농촌의 편의 시설이, 농촌 생활에 더 긍정적인 태도를 촉진하도록 향상되어야 한다.

readingSentences.english: The improvement for rural lives is doubly important, because the cities themselves cannot be developed without the prior development of the rural areas.
readingSentences.korean: 농촌 지역의 선행적 발전 없이는 도시 자체는 발전할 수 없기에, 농촌 지역의 개선은 두 배는 더 중요하다.
